reason: Document B convinces me to pledge again because it explicitly promises my money will be refunded if the campaign falls short—something Document A leaves out—and it shows the community only needs to raise $49,000, which is barely more than the $47,000 we actually managed to raise last time. Knowing Ruth Albers is behind it and that spending reports will be posted at the library makes me feel confident chipping in $25 or $50 even after my big donation to the ambulance fund.
